sources.title: Best practices for Claude Code
sources.quote: Most best practices are based on one constraint: Claude’s context window fills up fast, and performance degrades as it fills. Claude’s context window holds your entire conversation, including every message, every file Claude reads, and every command output.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, operating modes
sources.quote: Claude + Codex partnership — the initiating session stays the single root; one side implements and a fresh context on the other reviews the real candidate diff, every finding evidence-verified; decisions are formed jointly and presented for confirmation.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, confirm gates
sources.quote: Confirm gates (the only pauses): (1) the spec before any code; (2) User-Challenge decisions — decide, then present the call for a quick confirm, do not bounce open questions; (3) human-owned boundaries — PR merge, tag, publish, destructive actions.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, decision classes
sources.quote: Mechanical (code/spec/convention determines it → just do it), Taste (reasonable options, cheap to reverse → decide, state the call, proceed), User-Challenge (irreversible, boundary-crossing, or preference not inferable → pause at gate 2 with a recommended call).

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, working agreements
sources.quote: Push once per finished plan, never per commit: commit and verify locally as often as useful, then push once. Every push bills metered CI twice (push + pull_request), and this repo has exhausted its monthly quota twice.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, default-on hooks
sources.quote: Default-on hooks: verify-gate (Stop-completion evidence gate), loop-guard (repeated-failure stop), scope-addition-guard (PreToolUse: blocks a new non-ignored path or a dependency-manifest mutation; exempt in headless/CI unless ZOS_SCOPE_GUARD=1)

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: hooks, verify-gate
sources.quote: This is a forcing function, not a verifier: it only checks that the ledger is non-empty; it does not inspect what was checked or whether it passed.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: AGENTS.md, model routing
sources.quote: Stop an owner leg at N repeated failures (default 3), preserve the evidence and return to the orchestrator; changing model or owner never erases attempts.

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: README, strict scope
sources.quote: The most common failure with a capable agent is not a wrong line of code. It is work you never asked for, discovered later

sources.title: AI Engineering OS: README, strict scope
